# School Health Management System

This is a web-based application for school health departments to manage student health records, medications, medical events, vaccinations, and health check-ups.

## Project Features
- User authentication (login/registration) for parents, health staff, and administrators
- Student health record management (allergies, chronic diseases, medical history, etc.)
- Medication administration tracking
- Medical event recording and handling
- Medical supplies inventory management
- Vaccination process management
- Health check-up process management
- User profile management
- Dashboard and reporting functionality

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- Responsive design for various device sizes
